title: Choong-Moo

symbol.name: Choong-Moo
symbol.meaning: Admiral Yi Sun-sin · ITF pattern 9 of 24

note.p: Choong-Moo is the title given to Admiral Yi Sun-sin of the Joseon (Yi) dynasty, credited with the armoured turtle ship (geobukseon) of 1592. The pattern ends with a left-hand attack for his early death, before he could show his full ability. The diagram is I. You start in parallel ready stance in the middle of the A–B line facing D: knife-hand blocks and strikes and a fingertip thrust to B and A; down the stem, a side kick back toward C and a flying side kick toward D; on the E–F line, a grab and knee kick, a reverse knife-hand strike, turning and back kicks; back up toward C, a U-shape block, a jumping spin, fingertip thrusts and a back fist; then to B and A, a double forearm block, a block and back fist in sitting stance, two side kicks, an X-knife-hand checking block, a twin palm block, a rising block and a final left punch.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (30 movements; the flying side kick and the guarding block on landing in 9, and the front block and back fist in 24, are split into -1 and -2 here). Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; E and F are the ends of the far line, DE and DF the diagonals the turning kicks go toward. Finish by bringing the left foot back to parallel ready stance.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the A–B line facing D in parallel ready stance: feet parallel and one shoulder-width apart, fists in front of the belt.
Turn left: move the left foot to B into a right L-stance facing B (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Twin knife-hand block.
Step the right foot forward toward B into a right walking stance. Right knife-hand high front strike, the back of the left hand in front of the forehead.
Turn clockwise: move the right foot to A into a left L-stance facing A (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the left foot forward toward A into a left walking stance. Left flat fingertip high thrust.
Turn left: move the left foot to D into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Turn the face to C, drawing the right foot up beside the left knee into a left bending ready stance A, the body side-on to C.
Right middle side piercing kick toward C.
Lower the right foot toward C into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Step the right foot toward D and jump: right flying side piercing kick toward D, with a kihap.
Land toward D into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block.
Turn 270° counter-clockwise: move the left foot round to E into a right L-stance facing E (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left forearm low block.
Slip the left foot forward toward E into a left walking stance, reaching both hands up as if to take hold of the opponent's head.
Right upward knee kick toward E, pulling both hands down to meet it.

Lower the right foot beside the left foot, then turn and move the left foot to F into a left walking stance facing F. Right reverse knife-hand high front strike, the back of the left hand under the right elbow.
Right high turning kick toward DF, then lower the right foot beside the left foot.
Left middle back piercing kick toward F, fast after 14.
Land the left foot toward F into a left L-stance facing E (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Forearm middle guarding block.
Left middle turning kick toward DE.
Lower the left foot beside the right foot, then move the right foot to C into a right fixed stance facing C (right foot forward). U-shape block toward C.
Jump and spin round counter-clockwise, landing on the same spot in a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Knife-hand middle guarding block, with a kihap.
Step the left foot forward toward C into a left walking stance. Right upset fingertip low thrust.
Pull the left foot back into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right back fist side back strike toward D and left forearm low block toward C, together.
Step the right foot forward toward C into a right walking stance. Right straight fingertip middle thrust.
Turn 270° counter-clockwise: move the left foot round to B into a left walking stance facing B. Left double forearm high block.
Move the right foot toward B into a sitting stance facing C. Right forearm middle front block toward C.
In the same stance, right back fist high side strike toward B.
Turning counter-clockwise, right middle side piercing kick toward A, then lower the right foot toward A.
Turning clockwise, left middle side piercing kick toward A.
Lower the left foot toward A, then pivoting on the left foot turn into a left L-stance facing B (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). X-knife-hand checking block.
Move the left foot toward B into a left walking stance. Twin palm upward block.
Move the left foot along the A–B line, turning into a right walking stance facing A. Right forearm rising block.
In the same stance, left middle punch toward A.
